collections.staff.nurse_iwasaki_rumi.pre: “Sure! I will walk you through what happens next, step by step. If anything is unclear, just interrupt me. No need to be shy.”
“This part does sound a little scary. But taking our time to explain it now is better than leaving you guessing on the operating table, right?”
“Hey, do not just nod along. If you feel cold, hurt, or frightened, tell us. You do not have to put up with any of that to be a good patient.”
“All right, those are the main steps. Is there anything you would like me to go over again? Asking now can help you feel more at ease later.”
collections.staff.nurse_yoneda_shiori.pr: “Of course. I will explain the planned procedure one step at a time. Please ask whenever anything is unclear.”
“This part may feel unsettling. You do not need to remember every step at once, though. I can explain anything you did not catch again.”
“If any step makes you nervous, or you feel physically uncomfortable, please tell us directly. I will make a careful note of the questions you raise.”
“That concludes the explanation. Let me check once more: is there any step you are still worried about? Please tell us so we can go over it together.”
